title: CulFiT: A Fine-grained Cultural-aware LLM Training Paradigm via Multilingual Critique Data Synthesis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on cultural knowledge using multilingual open-ended and multiple-choice question-answering benchmarks (GlobalCultureQA, CANDLE500, CulturalBench, BLEnD), and measuring cultural value alignment by computing the Euclidean distance between LLM responses and human survey responses based on Hofstede's six cultural dimensions.

Measuring the inconsistency rate of model responses when answering the same questions translated across 14 different languages (using multilingual MMLU and MMMLU datasets), and comparing performance across high-resource and low-resource languages.
